synopsis: When Jing Mo showed demonic powers that was latent in his blood, his brother Jueming was forced to kill him. Jing Mo woke up to find himself reincarnated into the body of the boy Bai Zhu, but there seems to be something… strange about this body, too. Jing Mo wants to run away and hide his identity, but Jueming wants to find his brother's missing body and wouldn't let him go. One wants to hide, the other wants to find the truth, as they become embroiled in a deadly struggle over Bai Zhu's true nature. Instead, players must farm experience points to gain new skills and increase their status. Leah has acquired the hidden skill "Subordinate", which allows her to turn NPCs and monsters into her subordinates. title: Tokusatsu Gagaga
synopsis: Nakamura Kano is an OL (office lady) with a secret… she’s a “Toku Otaku,” a tokusatsu otaku who is obsessed with live action dramas of heroes, monsters and robots. She thinks they’re “JUST TOO COOL!” She’s so obsessed that she skips out on drinking with colleagues to watch it on TV and collects the DVDs, books and figurines. She lives her life by the code of the tokusatsu heroes, and constantly imagines them to help her through difficult situations. But this isn’t easy when all of her co-workers think that people who like anime and other childish things are weird, and they keep trying to make her socialize. Notes: Nominated to the 21st Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize.

With nowhere to go, Gald decides to enroll in a magic academy, something he never did in his previous life. In his past life—Gald was the strongest sage in history! Tasked by the Emperor, who fears it may be the work of the oni, Ariwara no Narihira encounters a young man named Sugawara no Michizane. This unlikely pair - the reclusive student Michizane and the famously charming Narihira, separated by class, birth, and nearly 20 years in age - team up to unravel the bizarre cases in Kyoto!
